name: q-harness
description: A collection of Claude Code Harness by phuquocchamp

plugins.name: q-panel
plugins.description: Draws each Bash call and each file change (Write, Edit, NotebookEdit) as a bordered panel, and frames the code blocks in replies with copy and collapse buttons.

plugins.name: q-graph
plugins.description: Shows the subagents and teammates of a session as a live graph: a roster band above the prompt, an alert when one waits for you, and a pane with the agent tree, what each agent used (tools, skills, MCP servers, rules) and the session's harness.

plugins.name: q-pilot
plugins.description: Runs browser tasks and UI tests from a prompt, like jev-ultrafast: Claude writes the task, Jev (TypeSafe) picks every step, Playwright executes it, and a live inspector shows and pauses each decision. Tests are graded by code, never by Jev's DONE; a passing test can be saved as a flow that the stop gate replays with no model when Claude edits UI.

plugins.name: q-advisor
plugins.description: Context advice at turn boundaries: focuses Claude Code's own autocompact on the plan, decisions and changed files, and suggests compacting, clearing for a new task or switching model, with Jev (Haiku fallback) making the judgement calls. Starts in shadow mode.

plugins.name: q-engine
plugins.description: A software engineering team as subagents (product manager, product owner, architect, engineer, database, debugger, reviewer, verifier) that hand work to each other through files, with /q-engine:feature and /q-engine:reproduce-bug workflows and coding-guideline, commit and Playwright CLI skills.
